encoding_rule.lineage_request: Internally tagged JSON object with discriminator op; capacity.begin, capacity.put, capacity.finish, and capacity.check fields are siblings of op with no args wrapper. capacity.begin.expected_open follows the clause-3a option convention: None omitted, present null rejected (v1.3.26).
encoding_rule.lineage_response: Externally keyed operation object for capacity.begin, capacity.put, capacity.finish, or capacity.check, following the clause 2 response convention.
encoding_rule.nested_unions: Internally tagged JSON objects retain discriminator kind; capacity.check upload carries ref:UploadRef; Known<T> is known{value}|unknown{reason}; nested DTO Option none is explicit null. CHECKED replay uses the complete canonical check_key, never digest alone.
encoding_rule.token_counts: Every TokenCount and ByteCount is a checked nonnegative JSON integer; inline bytes are base64 and capped at 1048576 raw bytes.
encoding_rule.implementation_status: No D5 lineage serializer exists at this baseline; owner-authored expectations pin the shared MC-gateway contract independently. Consumed and superseded sequence states contain no staged body bytes.
